title: Regulated sectors
description: The regulated sectors in each jurisdiction the Atlas covers, and the entity types in each. A user chooses a jurisdiction, then a sector, then the entity type. Each item validates against schemas/regulated-sector.schema.json.

items.name: Banking
items.description: Banks, building societies, credit unions and other authorised deposit-taking institutions

items.name: Insurance
items.description: General, life and private health insurers

items.name: Superannuation
items.description: Trustees of superannuation funds

items.name: Financial services and markets
items.description: Holders of an Australian financial services licence, such as advisers, fund managers and market intermediaries

items.name: Credit
items.description: Holders of an Australian credit licence, such as lenders and brokers

items.name: Payments
items.description: Providers of payment services

items.name: Listed companies
items.description: Entities listed on a securities exchange

items.name: Health
items.description: Hospitals, clinics and other providers of health services

items.name: Critical infrastructure
items.description: Owners and operators of assets a critical infrastructure law covers

items.name: Defence industry
items.description: Suppliers to the Australian Defence Force or the Department of Defence

items.name: Not financially regulated
items.description: Private companies and not-for-profits outside the sectors above
